## Repairs

**F1 — custody metadata: PASS in bounded acceptance.** Exclusive creation of a previously absent store directory permits initialization; an existing directory, including an empty directory, never authorizes reconstruction. Retained namespace, expectation bytes/linkage, root and lock identity and regular-file custody metadata are validated on reopen and before reservation, recovery and writes. Missing, malformed or conflicting metadata stops rather than recreates trusted state. Constructor failure closes its lock. Eleven custody cases cover missing store/expectation/lock, malformed store/expectation, conflicting store/expectation, unchanged valid reopen, live missing store/expectation and existing-empty rejection. The negative fixtures retain before/damaged/after byte maps; checks establish damaged == after. They are fresh synthetic fixtures, not historical records.

**F2 — malformed registration: PASS in bounded acceptance.** Explicit dictionary validation and controlled parse/type classification prevent scalar and other complete malformed registrations escaping recovery. Ten complete cases (null, number, boolean, string, array, nested array, wrong object, syntax, duplicate key, invalid UTF-8) produce ABORTED / RECORD_INVALID. Torn, empty and missing registration produce ABORTED / ATTEMPT_INCOMPLETE. Repeated recovery returns identical evidence; original malformed/torn bytes remain retained and their hashes bind the recovery disposition. No new refusal code or schema was introduced.

**F3 — ABORTED terminality: PASS in bounded acceptance.** Every normal writer and receiving invocation checks retained recovery disposition before proceeding. Final or interrupted recovery prevents continuation; stale journal writers also stop. For each of 21 ABORTED attempts, original and fresh writer objects attempt PREPARED, ATTEMPTED, ACCEPTED, REFUSED, registration and invocation: 252 STOP results, unchanged retained attempt bytes and no increment of receiver entries. Repeated recovery remains idempotent; conflicting evidence stops through existing recovery semantics.
